_DEPRECATED: This file is no longer used by the seeder as of migration v8-v9. Domain weights are now stored directly on topics via the weightPercentage field. This file is kept for backward compatibility only and will be ignored by the seeder.

_schema.certificationId: string  | FK → certification.id (slug). Must match the cert folder name.
_schema.domainName: string  | Official domain name from the exam guide. Should match topic titles.
_schema.weightPercentage: number | Percentage weight of this domain in the exam (0-100). All domains must sum to 100.
